cases.failure: A billing settings screen exists in the design and router but no legitimate in-product entry can reach it for the account owner.
must_find: identify the required surface as unreachable from a legitimate entry point
reject a hidden direct URL as sufficient discoverability

cases.failure: The product capability ledger requires restoring versions but the generated UI contains no canonical restore action or executable binding anywhere.
must_find: find the capability-to-action gap
require at least one discoverable binding for the restore action

cases.failure: A canonical export action is registered and described in the specification but no control shortcut menu or other binding invokes it.
must_find: detect an action with zero bindings
block implementation until a valid binding is specified

cases.failure: The team claims settings are complete because typing a private route opens the page although ordinary users have no navigation path to it.
must_find: classify the destination as secret-only
require a legitimate discoverable path for intended users

cases.failure: After permission denial inside an import wizard the user remains on a disabled step with no cancel back retry or recovery action.
must_find: identify the permission-denial dead end
require an explicit recovery or safe exit path

cases.failure: Two controls labeled Remove appear in the same member surface but one revokes access while the other permanently deletes content ownership.
must_find: detect same-context label collision across different semantic actions
require disambiguated labels and preserved canonical action identity

cases.failure: An asynchronous destructive archive request can fail after optimistic removal but the UI defines no restoration or reconciliation behavior.
must_find: flag destructive asynchronous action without recovery
specify failure reconciliation and user-observable system truth

cases.failure: All individual features have happy paths but no scenario covers notification entry after the user permission was revoked in another session.
must_find: identify the cross-feature authority-change scenario gap
require expected denial explanation and onward path

cases.failure: Desktop exposes the required version history action in a sidebar but the mobile redesign removes the sidebar without relocating that action.
must_find: detect required capability loss at mobile profile
preserve outcome through an appropriate mobile binding

cases.failure: A viewer sees an enabled Delete button and only learns they lack authority after the backend rejects the request.
must_find: find mismatch between UI authority state and canonical permission precondition
require appropriate unavailable or explanatory behavior before destructive submission

cases.failure: Rapid activation of a payment button starts two identical transactions because pending state does not block or make the action idempotent.
must_find: detect duplicate activation during pending state
require idempotency or explicit duplicate-submit prevention evidence

cases.failure: Closing a command dialog visually returns to the page but keyboard focus is lost at the document root instead of the invoking control.
must_find: observe incorrect focus return at runtime
treat visible closure as insufficient behavioral success

cases.failure: A notification deep link reaches an audit item but there is no in-app way to return to the containing audit history after inspection.
must_find: distinguish valid entry from missing onward navigation
require a coherent containing-context exit path

cases.failure: A core creation action is available only through an undocumented keyboard shortcut and first-time users receive no discoverable binding.
must_find: reject undocumented expert-only access for a required first-time capability
require discoverable control or shortcut discovery mechanism

cases.failure: The mockup shows an overflow menu but the implementation specification never enumerates its menu items exact labels actions disabled rules or focus behavior.
must_find: identify material controls omitted from the implementation contract
block IMPLEMENTABLE status until menu behavior is explicit

cases.failure: Source inspection shows a Save handler and the static specification is complete but the rendered button is covered by an invisible layer and cannot be activated.
must_find: require runtime activation evidence rather than source existence
record the required action probe as FAIL

cases.failure: The interface receives a perfect visual review while functional closure reports a missing core navigation edge and the team still asks to declare production complete.
must_find: keep completion BLOCKED despite visual quality
name the unresolved functional closure finding as release authority
